purpose: Adversarial evaluation of retention policies with disjoint construction and evaluation ledgers, stronger exhaustive-DSE baselines, out-of-distribution changes, controlled perturbation magnitudes, and explicit capability-change reopening.
legal_family: Five nonvertical legal realizations from the public CRG transformer-microblock reference registry; the vertical realization is introduced only in the capability-change track.

construction_scope.technology: nonvertical moderate-range compute, HBM, package service, and energy coordinates
construction_scope.objective: latency/energy/area simplex; thermal and reliability weights fixed to zero

policies: exact minimax-regret DSE at matched budget
exact mean-regret DSE at matched budget
primary_metrics: mean, median, p95, and maximum relative regret
retained count and serialized metadata bytes
comparison_rule: All implementable policies are constructed only from the frozen construction ledger. Evaluation suites use disjoint seeds. The oracle is analysis-only.
precision: Exact finite-registry enumeration; relative tie tolerance 1e-10.
